source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 16 January 1932, p. 11 ("Ards Seat Lost by One Vote")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Votes read from the page image: Filson 338, Baxter (retiring) 337; majority 1. 'The figures were confirmed on a re-count, which was asked for by Mr. Baxter.'

note: Annual election of the Newtownards Urban Council, January 1932. One vacancy in each of the five wards. Four wards were uncontested; Scrabo Ward was carried by a single vote after a recount. Printed: poll of over 75 per cent., 757 votes returned out of an electorate of 983, two spoiled. The printed poll of 757 does not agree with the two candidates' votes (675), so it is not entered as a total.
